slides.text: imagine a storm knocks the power out for days this winter… would your house actually be ready? 😨
pitch black by 4pm. phone on 4%. no wifi. and you're feeling around the kitchen for candles 😬
that's why I keep 2 of these solar lanterns in the cupboard. a lantern AND a torch in one 🔦
the clever bit? they charge in the sun on the windowsill or run off batteries… no plug needed ☀️
push it down and it turns into a torch… perfect for finding the fuse box in the dark
magnetic base, fold-out hook AND you can dim them, so you can stick or hang them anywhere

I'd rather have these in a drawer and never need them than be stuck in the dark 🕯️
6,500+ sold already and they're really cheap atm
it's in the basket ⬇️
